Marta Kowal-Brandt
DevOps / Platform Engineering | CI/CD, Kubernetes and Infrastructure Automation
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience and a strong focus on CI/CD, test infrastructure and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines and Kubernetes-based ephemeral test environments for three product teams. Experienced in improving delivery pipelines, automating environment lifecycle tasks, and making test systems more observable. Building further infrastructure experience through a personal k3s and GitOps homelab and Terraform practice.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health Software | 2023–2024
- Built short-lived environments for each merge request, deploying the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data to a shared Kubernetes cluster using Helm from GitLab CI.
- Automated environment cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; enabled QA and product reviews before merge and e2e tests against each environment.
- Technologies: GitLab CI, Helm, Kubernetes, Docker, Bash, PostgreSQL.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health Software | 2022
- Profiled pipelines across three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and separated e2e testing into its own stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by about 30%.
- Technologies: GitLab CI, Docker, pytest-xdist.

Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024–2025
- Operated a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, deploying applications from a Git repository with Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS using Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.
- Technologies: k3s, Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Terraform, Ansible.

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health Software | 2023
- Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and created Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
- The flaky test rate fell from 7% to below 1% after teams began addressing the top offenders.
- Technologies: Python, PostgreSQL, Grafana, GitLab API.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021–Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and e2e test stages and artifact publishing.
- Built and maintain merge-request test environments using Docker Compose and Helm on the company’s shared Kubernetes cluster; have namespace-level access.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright e2e suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Develop Bash and Python tooling for PostgreSQL test-data seeding.
- Wrote the internal “How our CI works” onboarding document and mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019–2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated approaches.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018–2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases, and reproduced bugs for developers.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Infrastructure and orchestration: Kubernetes (namespace-level access to a shared cluster), Helm, k3s, Terraform (personal project), Argo CD, Ansible (basic)
Monitoring and data: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, SQL
Programming and automation: Python, Bash, Java (test code), Git
Cloud exposure: AWS EC2 and S3 fundamentals through personal learning; Hetzner VPS (personal project)
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Operating systems: Linux

EDUCATION
BEng, Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam scheduled for January 2027; currently studying

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My experience centers on building and improving CI/CD workflows and Kubernetes-based environments that help product teams test and review software reliably. At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines and ephemeral test environments used by three teams of approximately 25 developers.

I have built merge-request environments deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster, with automated cleanup and e2e tests running against each environment. I also reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by about 30% by profiling and parallelising jobs, adding dependency caching and reorganising test stages. This work has involved making infrastructure workflows practical for developers, and I documented how the CI system works for team onboarding.

I am also developing hands-on infrastructure skills outside my current role. In my personal homelab, I run a three-node k3s cluster with GitOps deployment through Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana and Loki. I used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS and have learned AWS EC2 and S3 fundamentals. My cloud experience is personal rather than production AWS experience, and my Kubernetes work at Odrava is at namespace level on a cluster operated by the platform team.

Corvale’s new train fleet and the goal of taking its vehicle-to-cloud infrastructure from architecture through production make this a compelling opportunity to apply my platform and automation experience to a new domain. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in CI/CD, Kubernetes environments and operational tooling could support the Fleet Connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
